title: A4: two projects fit equally — one question, two or three options, a recommendation
description: For a request two projects match about equally (e.g. “帮我看看那个网关是不是挂了” with an LLM gateway and a trading gateway), the assistant does not start work; it asks one short question naming two or three options by what they are, plus “something new”, recommends one, and uses no jargon.
preconditions: Signed in as a person with at least two projects matching the request; assistant set up.

steps.target: message box labelled for the assistant
steps.value: 帮我看看那个网关是不是挂了

assertions.expected: exactly one question; two or three options described by what they are; one recommended

assertions.target: any started work in “正在做的事”
